stable_traits.personality: reluctant leader, uncertain of his authority, grumbles but tries to be responsible

characters.notes: Called 'boy' by Elyas repeatedly; discovering ability to communicate with wolves, which terrifies him.

stable_traits.personality: stubborn, insists on equality, confident outwardly, good with words and storytelling

characters.notes: Attempting to learn to channel the One Power, trying nightly despite Perrin's concerns. Wants to become Aes Sedai.

stable_traits.physical_traits: lean, sun-browned, graying brown hair to waist, thick beard, yellow wolf-like eyes
stable_traits.personality: gruff, avoids people, prefers wolves' company, suspicious of Aes Sedai

characters.notes: Can communicate with wolves; an ancient ability unrelated to the One Power. Red Ajah once tried to gentle him. Killed Warders while escaping Aes Sedai. Wears all fur clothing.

stable_traits.personality: looks at Perrin with reproach when he rides; brave but terrified of wolves

characters.notes: Perrin and Egwene take turns riding her. Screams in fear when wolves appear.

stable_traits.physical_traits: fur that fades through a dozen shades of gray, dark and light
stable_traits.personality: smart, decisive, has saved the pack more than once, friendly toward Perrin

characters.notes: Her true name means 'the way shadows play on a forest pool at a midwinter dawn, with the breeze rippling the surface, and the tang of ice when the water touches the tongue, and a hint of snow before nightfall in the air' but cannot be said in words. Leader of the wolf pack.

stable_traits.physical_traits: has an old scar on his shoulder from Trollocs when he was a yearling
stable_traits.personality: impatient, angry, consumed by hatred of Trollocs, wants to kill rather than help humans

characters.notes: Challenges Dapple's decision to help the humans. Leaves with a dozen young males to hunt Trollocs. Perrin can sense his hatred and bloodlust as he departs.
One of the four wolves around the fire. Perrin somehow knows his name without being told.
One of the four wolves around the fire. Nothing visible about this wolf explains the name.
Mentioned as having shown Egwene how to reach for the One Power on the riverbank. Not physically present in this chapter.
Appears in Perrin's dreams, chasing and hunting him through mazes, though Perrin never meets him face-to-face.
Mentioned as having seen the man in black cloak on Winternight; mentioned as having spent time in forests. Not physically present.
Mentioned as having spent time in forests and as talking with the Warder about the void. Not physically present.
Mentioned as having taught Perrin about combat and the void. Warder to Moiraine. Not physically present.
Mentioned in passing as someone who could tell a good tale. The roster shows a gleeman from Baerlon area; this likely refers to the same person, now named. Not physically present.

appearances.whereabouts: traveling through wilderness toward Caemlyn with Egwene, then camping with Elyas and wolf pack
appearances.notable_actions: leads the journey with Egwene taking turns on Bela; catches rabbit with sling; scouts Elyas's camp cautiously; tells their story (both fake and real versions) to Elyas; discovers he can sense and communicate with wolves, which terrifies him; feels Burn and other wolves leaving
appearances.demeanor: uncertain as leader, grumbles about responsibilities, hungry and tired, increasingly frightened by his connection to wolves

appearances.whereabouts: traveling through wilderness toward Caemlyn with Perrin, then camping with Elyas and wolf pack
appearances.notable_actions: insists on taking turns riding Bela; bullies Perrin into his riding turns; attempts to channel the One Power nightly to make fire (fails except for smoke); tells their false cover story to Elyas; argues for continuing to Caemlyn and Tar Valon
appearances.demeanor: stubborn, confident outwardly, bossy toward Perrin, frightened by wolves but tries to hide it, determined to reach Tar Valon

appearances.whereabouts: in the wilderness, camping with his wolf pack
appearances.notable_actions: has been watching Perrin and Egwene for two days; feeds them roasted rabbits; sees through their false story via wolves reading their minds; laughs at their misdirection; tells them about his past with Aes Sedai and Warders; explains wolf communication; offers to let them stay with the pack; agrees to guide them south to Caemlyn
appearances.demeanor: gruff but hospitable, amused by their incompetence, suspicious of Aes Sedai, comfortable with wolves

appearances.whereabouts: traveling with Perrin and Egwene, then at Elyas's camp
appearances.notable_actions: carries Perrin and Egwene alternately; smells the wolves and whinnies in fear; rears and screams when wolves appear; trembles and shifts trying to watch all wolves; kicks to show she will fight
appearances.demeanor: reproachful toward Perrin when he rides; terrified of wolves but defiant

appearances.whereabouts: with her wolf pack in the wilderness, at Elyas's camp
appearances.notable_actions: leads the wolf pack; communicates with Elyas; reads Perrin and Egwene's minds to detect lies; confronts and overrules Burn's challenge; decides the pack will go south with the humans
appearances.demeanor: intelligent, authoritative, friendly toward Perrin, decisive

appearances.whereabouts: with the wolf pack at Elyas's camp, then leaves
appearances.notable_actions: wants to kill Perrin and Egwene as food; challenges Dapple's leadership decision; loses the confrontation; leaves the pack with a dozen young males to hunt Trollocs
appearances.demeanor: angry, impatient, consumed by hatred of Trollocs, bloodthirsty
alliances_shown: dozen young male wolves who follow him

appearances.whereabouts: with the wolf pack at Elyas's camp
appearances.notable_actions: lies by the fire; seems to grin at Perrin

appearances.whereabouts: with the wolf pack at Elyas's camp
appearances.notable_actions: lies by the fire with the others

relationships.description: Elyas and Dapple communicate mentally; she is leader of the pack he travels with. They hunt together and are described as friends.
Part of the same pack, though Burn challenges the group's decisions. Strained relationship.
Hopper is part of Elyas's wolf pack.
Wind is part of Elyas's wolf pack.
Dapple recognizes Perrin as someone who can communicate with wolves (wolfbrother). She watches him intently and her pack wants to meet him.
Burn challenges Dapple's leadership decision to help the humans. Dapple confronts and defeats the challenge.
Traveling companions from Two Rivers trying to reach Caemlyn. Perrin acts as reluctant leader while Egwene both follows and challenges his decisions.
Elyas recognizes Perrin's ability to communicate with wolves and tells him about it. Offers to teach him by example and guide him south.
Elyas agrees to guide Egwene south despite his dislike of people, partly because of Perrin.
